title: My grandmother's recipe
instructions: Ali büyükannesinin çorba tarifini anlatıyor. Malzemelere ve süreye dikkat et.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: My grandmother makes the best lentil soup in the world.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Last weekend, she finally taught me her recipe.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: You need red lentils, an onion, a carrot, some butter and a little mint.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: First, you cook the onion and the carrot in butter. Then you add the lentils and water.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: It cooks for about thirty minutes.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: My soup wasn't as good as hers, but my family liked it.
